name: n4_semantic_export
description: Export the Project Haystack (hs:) tags of the components a NEQL query matches as a Haystack grid in the Haystack 4 JSON encoding (Hayson), read-only. One NEQL GET finds the components (default neql: hs:site or hs:space or hs:equip or hs:point; base_ord as n4_neql_query takes it), then each is read as n4_read_tags reads it (one load, plus one impliedTags call unless implied is false). Each row has id (a ref made from the slot path with its $-escapes decoded: '/' as '.', any character a Haystack ref does not allow as '_', ~2, ~3 on a clash), dis (hs:dis when set, else the decoded slot name), every hs: tag with the namespace stripped (marker, number, bool, string) and every outbound hs: relation as a ref (to the row's id when its endpoint, by slot path or h:<handle>, is exported too). Tags of other namespaces are left out; a value that cannot be converted is listed in skipped with why, never dropped silently. truncated says the NEQL match list was cut at max_entities. With save_as the grid is written as <state-dir>/exports/<save_as>.json (mode 600, never over an existing file) and the reply carries path and bytes; without it the reply carries the grid. Brick output is not produced.

neql.description: NEQL filter of the components to export
neql.default: hs:site or hs:space or hs:equip or hs:point

implied.description: Also export implied tags (one impliedTags call per component)

save_as.description: Write the grid to <state-dir>/exports/<save_as>.json instead of the reply (letters, digits, _ and -, up to 80)
